overclaims.abstract: The project was implemented in eight blocks of District Gumla of Jharkhand for three years from 2017-2020.
overclaims.body: Of the eight community development blocks in District Gumla, six were purposively selected as intervention blocks
overclaims.why: The body says only six of the eight blocks were intervention blocks, not that the project was implemented in all eight.

overclaims.abstract: A quantitative questionnaire was developed to collect data from school dropout girls of 10–19 years.
overclaims.body: The number of girls aged 14–19 years covered in the intervention and comparison arm corresponded to 314 and 272 at the baseline, 318 and 260 at the midline, and 402 vs 202 in the endline, respectively
overclaims.why: The body reports the sample as girls aged 14–19 years, a narrower range than the 10–19 years in the abstract.

overclaims.abstract: The proportion of girls continuing education, physical access to ICT devices at home, exposure to mass media and perceived physical security increased in the intervention arm at the midline and endline as compared to comparison arm in the baseline.
overclaims.body: The distribution of perceived physical security and exposure to mass media scores of adolescent girls in the intervention and comparison arms was not significantly different in baseline and midline.
overclaims.why: For mass media exposure and perceived physical security, the body reports no significant difference at the midline, so the abstract's midline increase is not supported.

overclaims.abstract: We conclude that such tailor-made training programs which are weaved within cultural contexts can effectively bridge the digital gaps in resource scare settings.
overclaims.body: So, it was practically very difficult to assess whether the improvement in outcomes was totally attributable to our program or was a combination of multiple projects operational in that area.
overclaims.why: The body says the improvement cannot be attributed wholly to the program, because other projects (including a Google digital literacy program) operated in the area, and no advanced statistics were applied.

overclaims.why: The body says a link to improved economic conditions could not be verified, so it does not show the economic gap was bridged.
